note.title: Note
note.description: the correction's note; default the summary

index.title: Index
index.description: the finding's position in the version, from 0

AppliedScope.title: AppliedScope
AppliedScope.description: The scope as sent to Hindsight: the tags and their strict match mode.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: exactly the parsed text at the offsets

span_start.title: Span Start
span_start.description: first character of the quote in the parse

span_end.title: Span End
span_end.description: one past the quote's last character

parser_version.title: Parser Version
parser_version.description: the parse the offsets are in (one of the version's `parses`); default the parse the version was recorded with

AssertionCreate.title: AssertionCreate
AssertionCreate.description: A researcher's new Assertion. Review fields are not accepted: it starts unreviewed.

AssertionRecorded.title: AssertionRecorded
AssertionRecorded.description: A mutation's result: the Assertion as it now is, and the audit event recording it.

superseded_by.title: Superseded By
superseded_by.description: the successor; required exactly when superseding

AssumptionTable.title: AssumptionTable
AssumptionTable.description:
One company's exposure through one product, in one currency. An input left out is
missing.

status.description: refreshed: `model.content` is the open gaps; otherwise why there are none

model.description: the Bottlenecks mental model, with its resolved citations

BudgetRequest.title: BudgetRequest
BudgetRequest.description: Per-run budgets (spec §7.4); unset ones take the configured defaults.

name.title: Name
name.description: the resolved entity's name, else the name the lead used

identity_key.title: Identity Key
identity_key.description: cik:, lei: or (no single entity) name:

lei.title: Lei
lei.description: only when no CIK identified it

source_path.title: Source Path
source_path.description: `sec` when a CIK was resolved; None: no automated source yet

counterparty_company_id.title: Counterparty Company Id
counterparty_company_id.description: the counterparty company with this Candidate's CIK (else its LEI): the company a commit promotes

ingest_note.title: Ingest Note
ingest_note.description: why no ingest was enqueued at commit

cik.title: Cik
cik.description: which of the resolution's SEC entities, when it offered several

mentioned_as.title: Mentioned As
mentioned_as.description: the name as the lead wrote it

mic.title: Mic
mic.description: the exchange's MIC, when Atlas knows the exchange

CandidateLead.title: CandidateLead
CandidateLead.description: A lead that named the Candidate's company, and how it named it.

CardBearContext.title: CardBearContext
CardBearContext.description:
The bear context about one company under one bear-checklist item: what the Skeptic
found on the checklist that contradicts no Claim. It marks no finding.

CardBearContextItem.title: CardBearContextItem
CardBearContextItem.description: One accepted bear-context item: what the quote says, and its span.

CardContradiction.title: CardContradiction
CardContradiction.description:
An accepted contradiction of the Claims it names, as the research card and a Hypothesis
carry it. (Cards drawn before the kinds list every accepted item here, some naming no
Claim, and have no `how`.)

CardDocumentRead.title: CardDocumentRead
CardDocumentRead.description:
A Source Version an Investigator or Skeptic task read, and the sections of the
passages it was sent.

CardFinding.title: CardFinding
CardFinding.description:
A research card finding in the §7.2 claim shape. The statement is the Editor's; every
other field is filled in by code from the accepted Claims it cites.

CardReading.title: CardReading
CardReading.description:
What one Investigator or Skeptic task read and what came of it, so a card with no
finding (or no contradiction) still says why. For an Investigator the counts are its
extraction's Claims; for the Skeptic (pilot fix 06) its proposed counterevidence items.

CardSearch.title: CardSearch
CardSearch.description:
What one round's Scout searched: its queries, how many leads they found, and the
leads the investigation took (in rank order; Tier C, never Evidence).

Check.title: Check
Check.description: One gold expectation, what was observed, and whether it held.

CitationSource.title: CitationSource
CitationSource.description: A world fact resolved to the Source Version section it was extracted from.

Claim.title: Claim
Claim.description:
One proposed Claim and its outcome. `proposed` is the Claim exactly as the model
answered; the other fields are what Atlas resolved from it (null when it couldn't).

role.description: `researched`: a universe company; `counterparty`: known only as the other end of Relationships (never ingested, never an investigation seed)

country.title: Country
country.description: None only for a counterparty no registry placed

counterparty.description: how entity resolution identified it, if it was created as a counterparty (kept once it is researched)

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: the themes the company belongs to

pending_identity_reviews.title: Pending Identity Reviews
pending_identity_reviews.description: identity mappings awaiting the owner, oldest first

relationships_out.title: Relationships Out
relationships_out.description: edges with the company as subject, its company-level edge (no object) among them

relationships_in.title: Relationships In
relationships_in.description: edges with the company as object

fetch_gate_blocks.title: Fetch Gate Blocks
fetch_gate_blocks.description: exchange requests the fetch gate blocked, newest first

id.title: Id
id.description: the Assertion reviewed, the Relationship rejected, the revised Source Version, or the counterevidence item

state.title: State
state.description: the Assertion's or Relationship's review state

contradicts_assertion_ids.title: Contradicts Assertion Ids
contradicts_assertion_ids.description: the version's Assertions this bears on

ContradictingEvidence.title: ContradictingEvidence
ContradictingEvidence.description: One piece of Evidence against the version: what changed, and where it is stated.

Counterevidence.title: Counterevidence
Counterevidence.description:
One item the Skeptic proposed and its outcome (like a Claim). An accepted item is an
Assertion (predicate `counterevidence`) on a Source Version the Skeptic chose, of one
`kind`: a contradiction of the Claims in `contradicts_claim_ids` (and `how`), or bear
context, attached to no Claim (`kind_reason` when the Skeptic proposed it as a
contradiction and code stored it as bear context). `independent`, a contradiction's only,
says whether its Evidence Family differs from every supporting Claim's (a Source Version
outside any family is its own). A rejected item keeps the kind proposed. `proposed` is the
item exactly as the model answered.

named_as.title: Named As
named_as.description: the company's name as the quote wrote it

source.title: Source
source.description: the registry whose one entity it is

CounterpartyOrigin.title: CounterpartyOrigin
CounterpartyOrigin.description: How a counterparty was identified when a quote first named it.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: A Source Version section that resolved citations lead to (Evidence, not Memory).

EvidenceAssertion.title: EvidenceAssertion
EvidenceAssertion.description: The supporting Assertion and the span it quotes (open it in the source viewer).

EvidenceFamily.title: EvidenceFamily
EvidenceFamily.description: Source Versions that are copies of one announcement: one witness.

EvidenceFamilyMembership.title: EvidenceFamilyMembership
EvidenceFamilyMembership.description: How a Source Version joined its Evidence Family (atlas.ledger.families).

EvidenceItem.title: EvidenceItem
EvidenceItem.description:
An accepted Claim of the investigation (the Evidence tray): the Assertion it became and
its source span. `excluded`: read by a task whose premise was disproven, so the Editor
leaves it out.

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description: One external fact the resolution used: where it came from and when it was read.

FetchGateDecision.title: FetchGateDecision
FetchGateDecision.description: Whether Atlas was allowed to request a URL, and which gate decided.

FetchObservation.title: FetchObservation
FetchObservation.description: One fetch of the document that produced or matched this version.

Filing.title: Filing
Filing.description: An `edgar_fts` lead's filing (EDGAR full-text search's metadata).

FinancialFigure.title: FinancialFigure
FinancialFigure.description: A canonical metric's value for one period and unit, as of the cutoff.

FinancialObservation.title: FinancialObservation
FinancialObservation.description: One XBRL fact of one filing, as of its filing's availability.

FollowUp.title: FollowUp
FollowUp.description:
A follow-up round: the open question it pursues, and the research card as it stood
when the round began.

question.title: Question
question.description: one of the research card's open questions

FxBasis.title: FxBasis
FxBasis.description:
How a value was converted from its reporting currency. Atlas has no FX source yet, so
every value is as filed and this is always null.

Headline.title: Headline
Headline.description: A TradingView news headline's metadata (a `tradingview_news` lead).

HypothesisContent.title: HypothesisContent
HypothesisContent.description:
A version's content. Only `findings` state facts, each citing accepted Claims (and so
their Assertions and spans); the rest is the Editor's or the researcher's proposal.
`unsupported_findings` records what was dropped for citing no accepted Claim: never
promoted to a finding. `contradictions` is the Skeptic's accepted counterevidence from the
investigation's research card (each finding lists the independent items against its
Claims in `counterevidence_ids`); versions drafted before ticket 15 have none.

investigation_id.title: Investigation Id
investigation_id.description: a stopped investigation with a research card

value.title: Value
value.description: the CIK, the LEI, or TICKER@MIC for a listing

owner_confirmation.title: Owner Confirmation
owner_confirmation.description: only the owner commits it (CIK↔LEI links)

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: a theme in the universe config

seed_company_ids.title: Seed Company Ids
seed_company_ids.description: the companies to investigate; default: the theme's companies

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: only Source Versions available by then are read; default now

InvestigationDocument.title: InvestigationDocument
InvestigationDocument.description: A Source Version an Investigator task read (counted against `max_documents`).

InvestigationLead.title: InvestigationLead
InvestigationLead.description: A Tier C lead the Scout found and the investigation kept (never Evidence).

InvestigationRequest.title: InvestigationRequest
InvestigationRequest.description: The shared agent contract's request (spec §7.2), as every role of the run works to.

InvestigationSummary.title: InvestigationSummary
InvestigationSummary.description: An investigation as the workbench lists it.

LLMAttempt.title: LLMAttempt
LLMAttempt.description:
One chat completion: the routed model, its usage, its raw content and why it failed
validation (None: it validated).

LayerDuplicates.title: LayerDuplicates
LayerDuplicates.description:
Edges recorded before migration 0055 that are one edge by today's identity (subject,
predicate, object) and differ only by layer. The first is the one new Evidence joins
unless it brings another of the group's layers.

Mechanism.title: Mechanism
Mechanism.description: §8.1's mechanism: what drives demand, what may constrain it, who may capture value.

MemoryDocument.title: MemoryDocument
MemoryDocument.description: One section of the Source Version, as retained (or linked) into the bank.

MemoryOperation.title: MemoryOperation
MemoryOperation.description: A Hindsight operation that retained (or reprocessed) some of the version's sections.

MentalModelRevision.title: MentalModelRevision
MentalModelRevision.description: The content a refresh replaced at `changed_at`, with its citations resolved.

Mention.title: Mention
Mention.description:
What a source said about a company. Any field may be missing; `mic` may be an
operating (XNAS) or segment (XNGS) MIC; `as_of` bounds historical names and listings.

PageAnchor.title: PageAnchor
PageAnchor.description: One PDF page's place in the parsed text: `text[start:end]`, in code points.

Passage.title: Passage
Passage.description: A stretch of one Source Version's parsed text sent to the Investigator.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description:
One identifier mapping the resolution supports: `cik`, `lei`, or a `listing`
(value `TICKER@MIC`, the listing's fields in `details`).

ProviderBudget.title: ProviderBudget
ProviderBudget.description: One provider's rolling window as the queue sees it now.

version.title: Version
version.description: the latest version; null before the first draft

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.description: why the version can't be published whatever the checks say

publishable.title: Publishable
publishable.description: not blocked and no check failed

PublishGateView.title: PublishGateView
PublishGateView.description: The publish gate for the latest version, read without publishing.

version.title: Version
version.description: the latest version, which must be unpublished

QueuePause.title: QueuePause
QueuePause.description: The queue-level pause: which kinds are held back, why, and until when.

QuoteSpan.title: QuoteSpan
QuoteSpan.description: A quote matched in the archived parsed text: code-point offsets, like an Assertion's.

QuotedText.title: QuotedText
QuotedText.description: Retrieved text passed to a role: always quoted, always low-trust data (spec §7.5).

ReadingPointer.title: ReadingPointer
ReadingPointer.description:
A recalled Memory resolved to a Source Version section, with the query that recalled
it (CONTEXT.md, "Reading pointer"; atlas.investigations.pointers): where Memory says to
read. `memory_text` is Memory as Hindsight returned it: an index entry, never Evidence,
never quoted.

response_schema.title: Response Schema
response_schema.description: a JSON Schema object for structured output; union types are refused

RefreshTrigger.title: RefreshTrigger
RefreshTrigger.description: When the model is refreshed, as the bank template defines it.

RelationshipRecorded.title: RelationshipRecorded
RelationshipRecorded.description: A mutation's result: the Relationship as it now is, and the audit event recording it.

ReplayAnswer.title: ReplayAnswer
ReplayAnswer.description: One question of the set: its scoped recall, and its reflect with resolved citations.

ReplayLeakage.title: ReplayLeakage
ReplayLeakage.description:
What the replay accepted from after its cutoff: every count must be 0 (§9.2).

Counted independently of the replay's own section ledger: from the Source Version each
retained version, recalled memory (its document ID and metadata) and resolved citation
names, checked against the versions the replay may see.

ReplayRecalledMemory.title: ReplayRecalledMemory
ReplayRecalledMemory.description: A recalled memory, with the document and Source Version it names.

cutoff.title: Cutoff
cutoff.description: only Source Versions available by then are retained; not in the future

company_ids.title: Company Ids
company_ids.description: the companies whose Source Versions are replayed and whose tags scope the questions; default: every company, the questions scoped by every theme

max_source_versions.title: Max Source Versions
max_source_versions.description: retain at most this many (the latest eligible); default and ceiling: ATLAS_REPLAY_MAX_SOURCE_VERSIONS

ReplaySourceVersion.title: ReplaySourceVersion
ReplaySourceVersion.description: A Source Version the replay may see, in retain order, with its retain's outcome.

ResearchCard.title: ResearchCard
ResearchCard.description: The Editor's structured research card: always a draft (spec §7.1, §7.3 step 10).

ResearchSnapshot.title: ResearchSnapshot
ResearchSnapshot.description: A snapshot read back and verified: `content` hashes to `sha256`.

ResearchSnapshotRecord.title: ResearchSnapshotRecord
ResearchSnapshotRecord.description: A snapshot's row: what was frozen, where, and its hash.

ResolvedAssertion.title: ResolvedAssertion
ResolvedAssertion.description: An Assertion span a scenario input cites.

ResolvedObservation.title: ResolvedObservation
ResolvedObservation.description: An XBRL observation a scenario input cites, with its full source.

token_budget.title: Token Budget
token_budget.description: the new token budget; larger than the old one

RetainOnDemand.title: RetainOnDemand
RetainOnDemand.description: Why a section should be retained now, and (optionally) the investigation asking.

RetainRequested.title: RetainRequested
RetainRequested.description: The on-demand decision recorded and the retain job that carries it out.

RoleCallRecord.title: RoleCallRecord
RoleCallRecord.description:
One call of a role. A quarantined call's outputs are visible in its attempts only;
`output` is set only for an accepted call.

RoutedDeployment.title: RoutedDeployment
RoutedDeployment.description: One deployment behind an alias: the provider model and LiteLLM's deployment ID.

version.title: Version
version.description: the Hypothesis version the scenarios attach to

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: the cutoff for the sources; default the investigation's

assumptions.description: the researcher's assumption table; omitted: the Financial Analyst's

ScenarioInputView.title: ScenarioInputView
ScenarioInputView.description: One input as the scenario used it, with its provenance.

segment_mic.title: Segment Mic
segment_mic.description: the segment MIC OpenFIGI matched, e.g. XNGS

SourceParse.title: SourceParse
SourceParse.description:
One parse of a Source Version: the one it was recorded with (`recorded`, the version's
own parse columns), or a re-parse under a later parser version (a `source_parse` row).

Task.title: Task
Task.description:
One role task of the plan. `depends_on` names tasks of the same round by key; a task
runs once each of them is done, and is cancelled when one of its premises is disproven or
every task it depends on was cancelled.

seeded.title: Seeded
seeded.description: the company row exists (open its dossier)

relationship_count.title: Relationship Count
relationship_count.description: edges naming it as subject or object

ThemeCounterparty.title: ThemeCounterparty
ThemeCounterparty.description: A counterparty company at the other end of a theme company's edge.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: upstream to downstream, empty ones included

relationships.title: Relationships
relationships.description: edges between the theme's companies (or to a product, or between one of them and a counterparty): those with no layer first (they belong under their companies, not under a layer), then by layer

counterparties.title: Counterparties
counterparties.description: the counterparty companies those edges name, by name

empty_layers.title: Empty Layers
empty_layers.description: layers with no company in the theme

TriageDecision.title: TriageDecision
TriageDecision.description: One decision about one section of a Source Version.

UnsupportedFinding.title: UnsupportedFinding
UnsupportedFinding.description:
A finding the Editor wrote that cites no accepted Claim of the investigation (or cites
something else): recorded, never shown as a finding.

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description: How much of each budget the investigation has used.

note.title: Note
note.description: why this version corrects the last

VersionCreate.title: VersionCreate
VersionCreate.description: A correction: the fields given replace the latest version's; the rest are kept.

VersionProvenance.title: VersionProvenance
VersionProvenance.description:
Where a version came from: the investigation and its run (the research card's Editor
call), and for the Editor's draft its own run and call.
